claim: The Anello Azzurro (Blue Ring) circumnavigates Lake Orta over three stages totalling about 43.6 km with 1,150 m of elevation gain, rated moderate.
quote: Total Length: 43.6 km ... Number of Stages: 3 days with 3-4 h/day ... Elevation Gain/Loss: 1,150 m each direction ... Difficulty: Moderate

claim: Anello Azzurro stages are Orta San Giulio–Pella (15.7 km), Pella–Omegna (11.8 km), Omegna–Orta San Giulio (16.1 km).
quote: Orta San Giulio to Pella — 15.7 km, 4 hours 20 minutes, 240 m elevation gain; Pella to Omegna — 11.8 km, 3 hours 28 minutes, 310 m elevation gain; Omegna to Orta San Giulio — 16.1 km, 4 hours 58 minutes, 600 m elevation gain

claim: The Blue Ring is marked with blue-ring 'Anello Azzurro' signs and red/white CAI marks, mixing trail, asphalt and dirt road.
quote: The route is mixed (trail, asphalt, dirt road) and is marked with 'Anello Azzurro' blue ring signs and red/white marks

claim: The Sanctuary of Madonna del Sasso stands on a granite cliff above Pella at 338 m, with a panoramic 'balcony of Cusio' overlooking most of Lake Orta.
quote: The Sanctuary of Madonna del Sasso stands on a granite rock rising above the village of Pella and the mirror of Lake Orta at an altitude of 338 meters ... the balcony of Cusio

claim: A signed hike climbs from Pella through Boleto up to the Madonna del Sasso sanctuary above the west shore.
quote: Hike Pella - Boleto - Madonna del Sasso

claim: Canoe Lago d'Orta in Orta San Giulio rents kayaks, SUPs and pedalos at the lakefront near San Giulio Island.
quote: Canoe Lago d'Orta Eco-Water Sports and Leisure Kayak SUP Pedalò Rental

claim: RS Rental in Pettenasco (Via 1° Maggio 1) rents kayaks, SUPs, e-bikes, scooters and cars for Lake Orta excursions.
quote: Noleggio Kayak, SUP, Biciclette Auto e Motorini Lago d'Orta

claim: Freedome offers guided kayak tours on Lake Orta from about €65, with shorter Pettenasco departures from €35 per person.
quote: Canoa e kayak Lago d'Orta | A partire da €65

claim: Lago di Mergozzo is described as one of the cleanest lakes in Italy thanks to its motorboat ban.
quote: one of the cleanest lakes in all of Italy ... No motorboats disturb its waters

claim: Lago di Mergozzo's strict no-motorboat policy and efficient sewage system make its waters among the clearest in Italy, ideal for swimming and SUP.
quote: Due to the absence of industrial activity, a ban on motor boats, and an efficient sewage system, its waters are amongst the clearest in Italy

claim: Lido di Gozzano is the largest beach on Lake Orta (about 150 m), with Europe's highest lake trampoline; open daily except Wednesday, 9:30–18:00.
quote: the largest beach on the lake and is characterized by the highest trampoline in a lake in all of Europe ... 150 meters long

claim: Pettenasco hosts Dolphin's Beach (bar, restaurant, showers) and Approdo (loungers, changing rooms, on-beach swimming pool); Pella's beach is in the Roncallo hamlet, reachable by car (14 km via SP229) or boat.
quote: Dolphin's Beach ... bar, restaurant, showers and toilets ... Approdo Beach ... deckchairs and umbrellas, changing rooms, shower, sinks, swimming pool on the beach ... Pella Beach ... Roncallo hamlet

claim: E-Bike Lago d'Orta in Orta San Giulio rents Scott e-bikes for adults, junior bikes for kids 9+, and child seats; open April–September, 9–18.
quote: Scott brand e-bikes ... junior e-bikes for children aged 9 and up ... open from April to September, from 9am to 6pm

claim: CCT Bike Rental delivers e-bikes around Lake Orta from Pettenasco, with delivery to Omegna, Stresa, Verbania, Arona or Ispra (3-day advance booking, 2-day minimum).
quote: Bookings must be submitted at least 3 days in advance with a minimum of 2 bike rental days. Delivery service is available around Lake Orta to places like Omegna, Stresa, Verbania, Arona or Ispra

claim: Lake Orta's average May water temperature is about 15.5 °C (range 11–21 °C) — cool for swimming without a wetsuit.
quote: In May, the average water temperature in Lake Orta is 15.5°C, with a minimum of 11°C and a maximum of 21°C

claim: Lake Orta is promoted as among Europe's cleanest lakes for swimming and watersports, including SUP, kayak and open-water swims.
quote: Sport water activity Lago d'Orta - splash the real nature
